narr: A weak push of monsoon moisture plus ongoing record heat fueled scattered thunderstorms over Mohave County. A few produced severe weather and flash flooding.
ev: A webcam showed the Archibald Wash flooded Pierce Ferry Rd.
Oatman Highway was closed from mile marker 40 to East Silver Creek Rd.
lsr: WEBCAM POINTING TOWARD PIERCE FERRY ROAD AT ARCHIBALD WASH SHOWS IMPASSABLE FLOODING OVER THE ROADWAY.
OATMAN HIGHWAY CLOSED FROM MILE MARKER 40 TO EAST SILVER CREEK ROAD DUE TO FLASH FLOODING.
